name: ai-code-review-assistant
description: AI-powered code review that evaluates branch changes against the existing repository's architecture and conventions.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:deps && npm run build -w @acra/api -w @acra/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:deps && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:deps && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
